# Pacific Marketing Solution

> Pacific Marketing Solution is a digital marketing agency with offices in Houston, Texas (USA) and Lahore, Pakistan. It combines SEO, AEO and GEO, paid advertising (Google Ads and Meta Ads), websites, content and creative work, AI chatbots and voice agents, CRM automation and white-label services to turn online attention into measurable growth. Pacific Marketing Solution is a startup by Unimind Studios Pvt Ltd.

Full text of every page in one file: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/sitemap.xml

Contact: info@pacificmarketingsolution.com

## Services
- [AI automation and CRM](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-automation-crm/): We set up CRM pipelines, lead routing and automatic follow-ups so no enquiry is missed. Plain-English help for small and growing businesses.
- [AI chatbots and voice agents](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-chatbots-voice-agents/): AI chatbots and voice agents that answer customer questions on your website, WhatsApp and phone, and book appointments around the clock.
- [Performance marketing](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/performance-marketing-funnels/): Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns built around cost per qualified lead, with landing pages, tracking and clear weekly reports.
- [Content, creative and video](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/content-creative-video/): Social posts, ad creatives and short videos made on a steady schedule, with AI to speed up drafts and people to keep it on brand.
- [Social media management](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/social-media-management/): Social media management for your business: content calendars, posts and short videos, replies to your audience and clear monthly reports.
- [Websites and apps](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/websites-digital-products/): Fast, mobile-friendly websites and landing pages designed to turn visitors into enquiries, with forms, booking and analytics connected.
- [SEO, AEO and GEO](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/seo-aeo-geo/): SEO, AEO and GEO explained simply: rank in search, win direct answers and get mentioned by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.
- [White-label services](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/white-label-services/): White-label SEO, website, content and ad management delivered under your brand, so your agency can take on more clients with confidence.

## Company
- [About us](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/about/): Learn about Pacific Marketing Solution, our digital growth approach, services, client experience, case studies and commitment to measurable results.
- [Case studies and results](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/work/): Real SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads case studies with the numbers: clicks, impressions, click-through rate, cost per click and more.
- [Contact](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/contact/): Contact Pacific Marketing Solution in Houston, Texas and Lahore, Pakistan. Send a message or book a meeting to talk about your marketing goals.

## Learn
- [Marketing insights](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/): Plain-English lessons from our own SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns: what the numbers show and what we would do next.
- [Marketing terms explained](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/glossary/): Plain-English meanings of common marketing words such as SEO, AEO, GEO, CRM, CTR, CPC, conversion, funnel and white-label.
- [Three SEO reports side by side: what the numbers show and what they hide](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/three-seo-reports-side-by-side/): See how three real SEO projects compare on clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position, and what each number does and does not tell you.
- [Fix indexing first: how the SEO for Allen Jacobi Law began](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/fix-indexing-before-writing-more-content/): Why search engines must index your pages before new content helps, and how fixing indexing for a law firm led to qualified leads by month three.
- [Clicks are not results: reading a Google Ads report from click to conversion](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/reading-a-google-ads-report-beyond-clicks/): Follow a $1,720 Google Ads campaign from impressions to cost per conversion, and learn why clicks alone do not show whether ads are working.
- [A $0.78 click is only good news if you can see what happens next](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/a-low-cost-per-click-needs-conversion-tracking/): A $0.78 click sounds cheap, but is it working? Learn why cost per click needs conversion tracking, using a real Google Ads campaign.
- [155,000 link clicks: what three Meta campaigns show about cost per click](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/meta-ads-cost-per-click-155000-link-clicks/): Three Meta Ads campaigns produced over 155,000 link clicks at PKR 1.63 to 1.95 each. See what the numbers show about cost per click and scale.
- [Clicks or conversations? Choosing the right Meta Ads objective](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/clicks-or-conversations-meta-ads-objective/): How to choose between link clicks and messaging conversations on Meta Ads, with real costs from three industrial-products campaigns.
- [What clients say they value most: themes from five testimonials](https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/what-clients-say-they-value-most/): We read our client testimonials for patterns. SEO results, quick replies and shared know-how came up most. Here is what clients said.

## Entity summary
- Company: Pacific Marketing Solution (legal name Pacific Marketing Solution LLC), a startup by Unimind Studios Pvt Ltd
- Category: digital marketing agency (SEO, AEO and GEO, paid advertising, websites, content and creative, social media management, AI chatbots and voice agents, AI automation and CRM setup, white-label services)
- Offices: 535 W Airtex Blvd, Houston, TX 77090, USA; 669 Shadman Colony, Lahore, Pakistan
- Customers: small and growing businesses and agencies; work shown includes health care, law, skin care, weight loss, solar energy, e-commerce and professional services
- Website languages: English (default), French, German, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Spanish (Mexico), Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Portugal)
- Contact: info@pacificmarketingsolution.com
- Evidence: case studies and campaign figures at https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/work/ and https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/ (numbers come from the Search Console, Google Ads and Meta Ads reports supplied with each project)
